chars.WIFE: a Moroccan woman about 24, long dark hair in a low ponytail, wearing a fitted camel-beige blazer over a white blouse, black straight trousers, small gold hoop earrings, light makeup
chars.HUSBAND: a Moroccan man about 35, short black hair, trimmed beard, wearing a dark green crew-neck sweater and grey jeans, tired eyes
chars.KIDS: two small Moroccan children, a boy about 6 in a red hoodie and a girl about 4 in a yellow dress with pigtails

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon storybook illustration, vertical. Seen from a doorway inside a modern Casablanca apartment, as if the husband watches: WIFE mid-act, grabbing her handbag and car keys by the front door, smiling to herself, checking her lipstick in a small hall mirror, ready to go out again. Head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible, subject in the centre, calm background at the edges. No text.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon storybook illustration, vertical. Evening living room in a Casablanca apartment: WIFE holds up her payslip and a car brochure excitedly, telling HUSBAND they will buy a car; HUSBAND sits on the sofa, surprised, slowly nodding. Both faces visible, centred. No text.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon storybook illustration, vertical. A Casablanca street in the morning: WIFE behind the wheel of a small new white car, sunglasses on her head, driving off happily alone, waving. Face visible, car in the centre, calm street at the edges. No text.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon storybook illustration, vertical. Late afternoon at the apartment entrance: HUSBAND, exhausted, carries school bags and leads KIDS inside by the hand, glancing at his watch, alone; through the window a cafe terrace far away. Faces visible, centred. No text.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon storybook illustration, vertical. Night, dim apartment hallway: WIFE in her blazer quietly leaving with her bag, smiling at a message on her phone; behind her, HUSBAND stands in the bedroom doorway in shadow, frowning, suspicious, watching her go. Both faces visible, centred. No text.
